objective: Test real lexical correspondences with unknown Gothic sign values and transfer to excluded source forms, before any Voynich application
known_input: Old Icelandic Language_ID302 Phonemic_Segments, canonicalized by the unchanged original IpaSequence parser
split: sort SHA256('phase51-test-v1|' + FormID); first31 test, remaining92 train
sequence_construction: independent shuffles with seeds51101/51102, consecutive pairs of lexical forms, no internal separator or Word object boundary; final singleton retained
native_annotations: one fixed known placeholder in every TSV row; native evaluator scores discarded
annealing: native schedule 0 to 3.5 insertion/deletion cost over2000steps, then1000steps
initial_final_comparison: same fixed final scoring: insertion/deletion3.5, temperature0.2, global_baseline1e-8; identical alphabets and known vocabulary
primary_metric: mean across5seeds of test recall: full original source word span and acceptable canonical target IPA, denominator19
secondary_metrics: annotated-match precision over all predicted spans
native phonetic alignment matrices with labeled axes
homophones: accept a documented canonical IPA equivalence class, not an unambiguous lexical meaning

permutation_reference.scope: conditional label-association reference, not a general false-positive rate for language detection

gate.interpretation_if_passed: partial lexical transfer under this dataset/model/normalization; does not validate translation or identify Voynich language

failure_policy: Keep all failures and outputs. No post-result parameter tuning. Startup-only code corrections must be separately recorded and refrozen before optimization. A timed-out search is incomplete, not a scientific negative.
